answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers verify it through periodic challenge rounds. A fake identity farm would need to post real capital per node, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation. Like timber grown on a knoll, reputation accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight; any whisper of duplicate behavior triggers slashing of the bond, so attackers lose more than they gain.
